Let the lines be at angles \(\theta = 0^\circ,1^\circ,\dots,179^\circ\).  
For a line of angle \(\theta\), its intersection with \(y=100-x\) has

\[
x=\frac{100\cos\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}.
\]

Pair \(\theta\) with \(90^\circ-\theta\) (mod \(180^\circ\)). For each such pair,

\[
x(\theta)+x(90^\circ-\theta)=100.
\]

The fixed angles of this pairing are \(45^\circ\) and \(135^\circ\).  
- \(\theta=45^\circ\) gives \(x=50\).  
- \(\theta=135^\circ\) is parallel to \(y=100-x\), so it has no intersection.

The remaining \(178\) lines form \(89\) pairs, each contributing \(100\). Thus the total is

\[
89\cdot 100+50=8950.
\]

\[
\boxed{8950}
\]
